They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The lantern street looked quieter than usual that evening. Nina believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Best of all, the boy read from the Torah at his bar mitzvah.

Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. People around Nina often share different ideas about the lantern street. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. For example, the wedding hosted the whole extended family.

Jack always says that small steps matter more than big plans. At first, Nina found it difficult to keep the habit. Nina bought a T-shirt online because it was much cheaper. The festival offers a smorgasbord of genres.

The temple fair has become an important part of daily life. Nina has practiced basketball for three years and won a prize last term. The experience taught Nina more than any book could. For example, she boldly asked the boss for a raise.
Little by little, things began to change. Nina usually spends the weekend reading at the library. Nina wrote down every idea in a small notebook.
